title: Valère Géron - You Don't Want My Heart
htmlContent:
Valère Géron drops a wonderful single called "You Don't Want My Heart," a superb display of artistry that you can admire. The sound is innovative and packed with mass appeal, that is packed with incredible melodies that you hope never end. The single “You Don’t Want My Heart” begs to be heard live, charging forward with a measured yet infectious energy which is not in the least place driven by the characteristic Motown snare and the “in your face” pounding bassline that the song opens with right out of the gate.

Valère Géron makes a record that’s enjoyable in every way with the new song “You Don’t Want My Heart”. The production sets the perfect tone with the music, as his vocal performance guides the way on what is an amazing musical experience.
